mentions.name: AzOS Second Edition
mentions.description: A web-based recreation of the Windows 98 desktop GUI built in pure HTML, CSS, and JS, featuring desktop theming, file management, and programs recreated from scratch or embedded from existing ports. Includes faithful recreations such as Minesweeper, Media Player, and screensavers, plus spins like a ChatGPT-enhanced Clippy and a syntax-highlighting Notepad, along with embedded well-known projects such as JSPaint, JS-DOS, and Emscripten ports.
mentions.problem: Existing retro Windows web recreations did not accurately capture the joy of desktop customization the author was looking for.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm recreating Windows 98 desktop GUI faithfully in pure HTML, CSS, and JS, complete with desktop theming, file management, and some programs recreated from scratch or embedded from existing ports.
